result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, **Linear is the best project management tool overall** if you're building a tech product. However, the best choice depends on your team's size, working style, and whether you're managing software development, business operations, or both.

My recommendation is to prioritise three things\:

1. **Simplicity** – your team should be able to start using it without extensive training.
2. **Visibility** – everyone should know what they're working on, what's blocked, and what's coming next.
3. **Scalability** – it should support your growth without becoming an administrative burden.

## The best project management tools for startups

![Linear Next.js Mockup](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9g7Jz18ye18cagdYuuVfNgN-poQJdA_cd7uivPZx9xuE_eIruo7HDinuVwx0BorL0lTdacJHgg33Iwf46f7tYiKxjmqAVhCmkrefTw6_pKFwDn06TIN1HgyAJiPaGLjL0hWvlbScRJbYesmtC-jp_52My8hPNfrjGkoINEr1170JRf7JdKVHPIDA0IuHtSrR?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product roadmaps and sprint planning.
- Great GitHub integration.
- Fast, clean interface.
- Less suited to marketing and general operations.

Free plan; paid plans from around \$10/user/month.

[Visit Linear](https://linear.app/)

---

![Finastra Customer Story | ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OXxUksa73j7hoTxbYQ6zo3pspX36GflPBLMsRWXjhfWZTJdFq6md_tXaxCCc_3Kjh0xQSrUSgXoCYi3d5TOe48r-mvzFwLplQbgf4lhsH3q_bsATt_hAcyva5qI1DtZG8OasgRxxldReZAIfURcJdNdt2Br8nPVvqn-lCO5aR2MxpFl9QAiCxibf4gzehOOb?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-rounder)

- Tasks, projects, docs and goals in one place.
- Lots of customisation and automation.
- Good for cross-functional teams.
- Can become overly complicated if you customise everything.

Free plan; paid plans from around \$7/user/month.

[Visit ClickUp](https://clickup.com/)

---

![Project Management Hub Template by Gridvio | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6e1oG6Y_aW5V5yDl222hE8Y8t-T__05L0OPLqrtY2b6KrmvS_M-QH4eaVLv4afPJUAGCFGr_eoifL-Irt3_HiUqUmKW08dRjhIxW2MfVWL_nPAWNaujkMp5zdq2VbJkW7b3h6jvrTVNAFmmVU9MPLCBztqWrhslDc_LeRhpbcV451et11onvlpgBLkBnIYcR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

(Best for early-stage teams)

- Project management and company wiki.
- Meeting notes, SOPs and documentation.
- Flexible databases and task tracking.
- Less powerful for complex project execution.

Free plan; paid plans available.

[Visit Notion](https://www.notion.com/)

---

![New: Asana’s Milestones help you visualize project progress • Asana](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/045PY8MNTZCNbuEY_9zoc2ZmyVm82bEUQrACKq4DMJ2rZRzBOKtwnHDDeSB865DF__R-b4CGI6GEhHdu4YJMzkB1qcjJuCRLXmMhkxG9zfIfGx-0L1EgDFt_aMUwOdh5HR45ijTcFpeq8HRM8juB5v_Vffpp7OzTfiaEKInBCXkUCm5590f5v87DKC8sKsga?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Excellent task ownership and accountability.
- Strong project timelines and dependencies.
- Good for marketing, operations and sales.
- Can be more structured than a tiny startup needs.

Free plan; paid plans from around \$10.99/user/month.

[Visit Asana](https://asana.com/)

---

![Monday Vibe | Build Custom Apps with Vibe Coding & AI Prompts](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/dZbPOy2ExCYPWkRUN-y8aNBArPHAy5RJyF2Fv3kOH8r0onm7GzQMtNgFLnlF_orijMr1L_hlS3rZ5CmII7wcg1sC5QIg6R8JlCgddpaNU2x9UGq4FrFp6DOJXu4JvN0TyREqPyEMky1tg6L3RhInST4tHJiMa0BGxgH61Ibvrnb8NABR1soD10zbitKXa9pg?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Monday.com**

- Excellent visual dashboards.
- Great for managing multiple departments.
- Useful automations and reporting.
- More setup than some early-stage teams need.

Paid plans from around \$9/user/month.

[Visit Monday.com](https://monday.com/)

Pricing is indicative USD pricing and can vary by billing frequency, plan and region. Sources: [www.techrepublic.com](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/project-management-software-for-startups/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[hackceleration.com](https://hackceleration.com/labs/best/startup-project-management-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[waveup.com](https://waveup.com/blog/7-best-project-management-software-for-startups-in2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to two options\:

- **ClickUp\:** If you want one platform to manage the entire startup.
- **Linear + Notion\:** If you're building a technology or SaaS startup and want excellent product execution alongside company documentation.

I wouldn't invest in an overly complicated project management system at the beginning. Your team needs clarity and accountability more than dozens of features.
